# SmartFill design language

> Geist Sans, monochrome foregrounds, white panels on a near-white canvas, soft gray controls, compact 32px selection rows, pill segmented controls and primary actions. Use the shared semantic tokens and primitives everywhere. Panels use a subtle neutral ring and layered shadow; color communicates a real status or belongs to the existing brand asset. No decorative gradients, glow, glass, or blue-tinted neutrals.

This document merges the technical contract from [UI-SYSTEM.md](docs/UI-SYSTEM.md) with the user's explicitly requested reference revision. It describes the implementation, not an automatic authorization for future restyling.

## Reference and capture context

Reference: [AI SDK Agents model picker](https://www.aisdkagents.com/ai-components/model-picker), its public [demo](https://www.aisdkagents.com/view/model-picker-demo), the user's two screenshots and pasted shadcn-style theme guidance. Inspected on 5 November 2026 with desktop Chromium, plus Firecrawl branding extraction. The [AI Elements docs](https://www.aisdkagents.com/docs/blocks/ai-elements) describe React patterns; SmartFill retains its existing React/Plasmo architecture.

The public DOM verifies Geist Sans, 13px trigger text, 14px menu text, a 320px menu class, 16px menu corners, 6px menu padding and small neutral shadows. Desktop navigation uses 32px rows and 13px text. The reference screenshots are [site](docs/ui/reference-site.png) and [picker](docs/ui/reference-picker.png). The initial picker capture includes its entrance animation; exact layout measurements come from DOM styles rather than scaled screenshot pixels.

The premium component source is not used. [SelectPicker.tsx](src/components/SelectPicker.tsx) is an original implementation of the visible pattern. SmartFill adapts it to real industry/region/provider/model choices; it does not invent model pricing, context windows, or reasoning controls.

## 1. Foundations

### Fonts and type

[fonts.css](src/styles/fonts.css) bundles variable **Geist Sans** as `SmartFill Geist`, weights 100–900, with Arial/sans-serif fallback. The [OFL license](src/assets/fonts/OFL.txt) accompanies the local font. No remote font request is needed. [font.ts](src/styles/font.ts) registers the same font for shadow-root controls through the FontFace API. Its data module is generated from the local asset.

Use weights 400, 500 and 600. Headings use sentence case; no uppercase navigation labels. Use tabular numerals for changing counts. Compact extension and picker text intentionally uses the reference's 12–14px scale, overriding the portable craft skill's generic website body-size suggestion.

| Role | Implemented scale | Definition |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Body/settings controls | 14px, line-height 1.5 | [theme.css](src/styles/theme.css), [tokens.ts](src/styles/tokens.ts) |
| Picker trigger/rows | 13px, 20px line-height | [picker.css](src/styles/picker.css) |
| Supporting copy | 12px, 18px line-height | [popup.css](src/styles/popup.css), [options.css](src/styles/options.css) |
| Popup title | 15px/22px, 600 | [popup.css](src/styles/popup.css) |
| Settings title | 24px/32px, 600; 20px at narrow width | [options.css](src/styles/options.css) |

### Semantic colors

[tokens.ts](src/styles/tokens.ts) is the canonical source. [tokens.css](src/styles/tokens.css) is generated; do not edit it. Light is the default regardless of system appearance. Dark tokens require an explicit `data-theme="dark"` attribute; there is no automatic system-theme switch. The vocabulary follows the supplied background/foreground convention.

| Role | Tokens |
| --- | --- |
| Canvas | `--background`, legacy alias `--page` |
| Panel | `--card`, `--card-foreground`; legacy `--bg` |
| Floating picker | `--popover`, `--popover-foreground` |
| Primary text | `--foreground`, legacy `--text` |
| Soft control/secondary text | `--muted`, `--muted-foreground` |
| Main action | `--primary`, `--primary-foreground` |
| Hover/selection | `--accent`, `--accent-foreground` |
| Borders/focus | `--border`, `--input`, `--ring` |
| Navigation | `--sidebar`, `--sidebar-foreground`, `--sidebar-accent`, `--sidebar-border` |
| Feedback | `--success`, `--warning`, `--destructive` and corresponding soft backgrounds |

Budget: **zero decorative accent colors per view**. Use semantic feedback only when there is an actual result, recording state or destructive action. The existing SmartFill icon is the sanctioned multicolor exception. Artwork and the bundled font asset remain unchanged in meaning.

Legacy `--surface` aliases the muted surface; `--muted` is a background, never a text color. Secondary text must use `--muted-foreground`.

## 2. Surfaces and elevation

| Surface | Recipe |
| --- | --- |
| Settings/popup panel | `.card`, 20px radius, neutral ring and `--shadow` |
| Picker popup | `.ui-picker-popup`, 16px radius, 6px inset, `--shadow-popover` |
| Picker row | `.ui-picker-option`, 32px minimum height, 10px radius |
| Filled control | `--radius-control` = 12px, muted surface |
| Segmented rail/main popup action | `--radius-pill`, white selected segment on gray rail |

The shadow tokens in [tokens.ts](src/styles/tokens.ts) own layered elevation. Do not inline a competing palette or shadow family on a new screen. Nested soft surfaces follow [popup.css](src/styles/popup.css) and [options.css](src/styles/options.css); they do not get an extra shadow. Status colors never replace the panel palette.

## 3. Layout and components

- The popup is **380px wide**, with compact **12px outer / 16px panel padding**, one mode rail, one main form panel, integrated field disclosure and quiet footer. Chrome's popup height limit is handled with vertical scrolling. Record and replay has been removed.
- Settings uses a centered 1120px shell, 24px top / 20px horizontal page padding, a rounded 216px sidebar with 16px/12px padding, and main panels with 20px padding (16px at narrow widths). At 600px and below navigation wraps above the content. These are SmartFill adaptations, not claims about reference mobile behavior. Remove redundant whitespace, never all content padding.
- Spacing uses the 4/8/12/16/20/24/32px rhythm. Existing popup optical gaps of 10/18px are intentional composition values.
- Use [Button, IconButton, Field, Section and Badge](src/components/ui.tsx), [Status](src/components/Status.tsx), and [SelectPicker](src/components/SelectPicker.tsx). Native HTML controls inherit the shared base styles.
- `SelectPicker` uses a fixed **320px** menu clamped to the viewport. Search, grouping, checkmarks, active-row background and optional information footer share one skin. Custom model IDs are supported only where the caller enables them.
- Icons use the existing [SVG icon system](src/components/icons.tsx), usually 13–16px; menu search uses a matching 16px outline. Icon-only buttons require accessible names.
- Preserve native radio semantics for segmented choices. Arrow keys move the selection. Menus support arrows, Enter and Escape, restore focus, close outside, and keep long lists scrollable.
- Labels persist after typing. `Field` associates its label and supporting text to one contained native control. `SelectPicker` requires an explicit accessible label.

## 4. Motion

List exact transition properties. Shared controls use approximately 140–150ms color/border transitions; picker entrance is 120ms. Loading spinners communicate progress. [theme.css](src/styles/theme.css), [picker.css](src/styles/picker.css) and the [overlay styles](src/lib/picker/styles.ts) honor reduced motion. Do not add page-wide entrance choreography or animate whole settings groups.

## 5. Per-page checklist

- [ ] All colors and elevation reference semantic tokens; no tinted neutral or decorative gradient.
- [ ] Geist is loaded locally; secondary text uses `--muted-foreground`.
- [ ] Controls use shared primitives and semantic HTML; labels, focus and selected states are exposed.
- [ ] Menus are 320px maximum, viewport-safe, keyboard-operated and scrollable.
- [ ] Both appearances and narrow settings layouts remain readable without horizontal overflow.
- [ ] Fill/undo, provider settings, custom model IDs, voice configuration and pinned values retain their behavior.
- [ ] Relevant tests, TypeScript, production build and browser review have passed.

## Fidelity limits

The reference's source is gated. The implementation matches inspected visual patterns with original code, retaining SmartFill's brand icon and extension-specific layout. Live provider calls, real microphone permissions and installed-extension permission flows require a separate configured-browser check.
